SYMPTOM: Build fails at static generation step with `useContext` error in `_global-error` page
CAUSE: Next.js 16 internal bug — the useContext call is in Next.js's own minified code, not user code. SessionProvider in the root layout triggers it during prerendering of special pages.
FIX: None available. Creating a custom `app/_global-error.tsx` doesn't help. Don't upgrade Next.js versions to chase this.
PREVENT: Accept it as a pre-existing Next.js 16 bug. Build still compiles clean — only fails at static page generation step for this one internal page. Does not affect runtime behavior.
NOTE: `_not-found` CAN be fixed with a custom page + Suspense wrapper.
